basics.Current Status: Ph.D. Intern, Machine Learning at Meta Platforms
basics.summary: Researcher combining bioinformatics and applied AI/ML. Work spans interpretable pathogen genomics, protein representation learning, generative-AI evaluation, and large-scale recommendation systems. Experience connects experimental science, model development, and evaluation in research and production settings.
basics.Research Focus: Applied AI/ML | AI for Science | Bioinformatics | Data Mining

work.name: Meta Platforms
work.summary: Developed LLM-based music and creator recommendation systems for content creation.
highlights: Built pipelines for semantic tokenization, supervised fine-tuning, preference optimization, and online evaluation.
Designed Atomic Creator Tokens for creator recommendation.

work.name: Capital One
work.position: Ph.D. Data Science Intern, AI Foundation
work.summary: Investigated graph representation learning using data from approximately two million customers to predict shared accounts and support customer modeling and fraud-risk analysis.

work.name: Metagenomi
work.summary: Developed preprocessing, feature engineering, and ML/deep-learning models for CRISPR nuclease indel profiles and gene-editing outcomes using internal screening data.

editorial.name: Frontiers in Microbiology — Microbiome Data Science
editorial.summary: Appointed to the section editorial board to review manuscripts in computational, statistical, and informatics approaches to microbiome research.
